name: PPWO Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The PPWO's top singles title sat vacant throughout this collection's own holdings window, named in the fed's own Handbook and newsletter but never once billed with a challenger or a match.
notes: Source: PPWO Matchwatch Newsletter, Vol.1 Iss.4 (eIYX69HId2IJ), 11 Dec 1997: "PPWO Heavyweight Champion: Vacant."

name: PPWO Arizona State Championship
epitaph: The PPWO's regional secondary title found its first and, in this collection's holdings, only champion in J'ster, whose reign the fed's own newsletter still carried unbroken as of its last surviving issue.
notes: Source: PPWO Matchwatch Newsletter, Vol.1 Iss.4 (eIYX69HId2IJ), 11 Dec 1997: "Arizona State Champion: J'ster, Record: 2-0-0, Title Reign: 11/23/97 - Today."

name: PPWO Grand Canyon Championship
epitaph: A cruiserweight title created sometime before the held record's mid-December snapshot, and vacant every time the fed's own newsletter reported on it.
notes: Source: PPWO Matchwatch Newsletter, Vol.1 Iss.4 (eIYX69HId2IJ), 11 Dec 1997: "Grand Canyon Champion: Vacant." Not mentioned in Handbook v1.0 (23 Nov); present by the newsletter's own 11 Dec issue -- created sometime in that window, not otherwise dated.

name: PPWO Tucson Heavyweight Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The PPWO's tag championship, held by Money and Power from their crowning in early November 1997 through the end of this collection's own holdings, undefeated across the three defenses the fed's own newsletter records.
notes: Source: PPWO Matchwatch Newsletter, Vol.1 Iss.4 (eIYX69HId2IJ), 11 Dec 1997: "Tucson Tag Team Champions: Money and Power, Record: 3-0-0, Title Reign: 11/8/97 - Today."
